title: Aaron Glenn: We'll know more on Geno Smith's ankle this week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Glenn: We'll know more on Geno Smith's ankle this week
sources.description: Jets quarterback Geno Smith left Sunday's game with an ankle injury and head coach Aaron Glenn didn't have any update on his condition after their 31-12 loss to the Bills.
